description_en: Queries the list of queue information
name: CloudListQueue

parameters.help_en:
The call center ID.

Before calling this operation, create a call center instance in the Cloud Call Center console and obtain the instance ID from the instance access URL
parameters.help_zh:
呼叫中心 id

调用前需在云联络中心控制台创建呼叫中心实例，并从实例访问地址中获取实例 ID
parameters.name: enterprise_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return. The value must be a positive integer greater than 0 and cannot exceed 500. Default value: 500
parameters.help_zh: 条数；正整数，大于0，最大不能超过500， 默认为500
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The start position of the query. The value must be a non-negative integer. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 第几条开始；正整数 大于等于0 默认为0
parameters.name: offset

parameters.help_en:
The sort order by creation time. Valid values:
0: ascending order.
1: descending order
parameters.help_zh: 排序方式,按照创建时间排序；0正序 1倒序
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the creation time range. Example: "2019-10-11 00:00:00".

Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
parameters.help_zh:
创建时间起始时间点；取值说明："2019-10-11 00:00:00"

格式：yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the creation time range. Example: "2019-10-11 23:59:59".

Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
parameters.help_zh:
创建时间终止时间点；取值说明："2019-10-11 23:59:59"

格式：yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
parameters.name: end_time

AnnouncePosition.description_en:
The position announcement mode. Valid values:
0: disabled.
1: plays when the queue position is greater than announce_position_param.
2: plays when the queue position is less than or equal to announce_position_param
AnnouncePosition.description_zh: 位置播报 0关闭 1大于announce_position_param时播放 2小于等于announce_position_param时播放
AnnouncePosition.title_en: 位置播报 0关闭 1大于announce_position_param时播放 2小于等于announce_position_param时播放
AnnouncePosition.title_zh: 位置播报 0关闭 1大于announce_position_param时播放 2小于等于announce_position_param时播放

AnnouncePositionFrequency.description_en: The interval for position announcements. Unit: seconds

AnnouncePositionParam.description_en: The threshold for position announcement. The announcement is played when the number of callers is more or fewer than this value. The value must be greater than or equal to 2
AnnouncePositionParam.title_en: 多余少余n个时播报，必须大于等于2
AnnouncePositionParam.title_zh: 多余少余n个时播报，必须大于等于2

AnnouncePositionYouarenext.description_en:
Specifies whether to announce "You are next". Valid values:
0: disabled.
1: enabled
AnnouncePositionYouarenext.description_zh: 是否播报'您是下一位',0关闭，1开启
AnnouncePositionYouarenext.title_en: 是否播报'您是下一位',0关闭，1开启
AnnouncePositionYouarenext.title_zh: 是否播报'您是下一位',0关闭，1开启

AnnounceSound.description_en:
Specifies whether fixed voice announcement is enabled. Valid values:
0: disabled.
1: enabled
AnnounceSound.description_zh: 播报固定语音 0关闭 1打开
AnnounceSound.title_en: 播报固定语音 0关闭 1打开
AnnounceSound.title_zh: 播报固定语音 0关闭 1打开

AnnounceSoundFrequency.description_en: The interval for playing the fixed voice announcement. Unit: seconds
AnnounceSoundFrequency.description_zh: 播放固定语音周期，秒数
AnnounceSoundFrequency.title_en: 播放固定语音周期，秒数
AnnounceSoundFrequency.title_zh: 播放固定语音周期，秒数

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time. Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
CreateTime.description_zh: 创建时间，格式: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
CreateTime.title_en: 创建时间，格式: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
CreateTime.title_zh: 创建时间，格式: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss

JoinEmpty.description_en:
Specifies whether callers can join when the queue is empty. Valid values:
1: busy.
2: in call.
4: ringing.
8: invalid.
16: wrap-up
JoinEmpty.description_zh: 队列中为空时是否可以join，取值：1：置忙 2：通话中 4：振铃 8：无效 16：整理
JoinEmpty.title_en: 队列中为空时是否可以join，取值：1：置忙 2：通话中 4：振铃 8：无效 16：整理
JoinEmpty.title_zh: 队列中为空时是否可以join，取值：1：置忙 2：通话中 4：振铃 8：无效 16：整理

MaxLen.description_en: The maximum number of waiting calls. Valid values: 0 to 999. A value of 0 indicates no limit
MaxLen.description_zh: 最大等待数，设置范围0-999，0表示不做任何限制
MaxLen.title_en: 最大等待数，设置范围0-999，0表示不做任何限制
MaxLen.title_zh: 最大等待数，设置范围0-999，0表示不做任何限制

MemberTimeout.description_en: The agent timeout period. Valid values: 20 to 60. Unit: seconds. Default value: 25
MemberTimeout.description_zh: 座席超时时间，取值范围20-60秒，默认25秒
MemberTimeout.title_en: 座席超时时间，取值范围20-60秒，默认25秒
MemberTimeout.title_zh: 座席超时时间，取值范围20-60秒，默认25秒

QueueTimeout.description_en: The queue timeout period. Valid values: 5 to 600. Unit: seconds. Default value: 600
QueueTimeout.description_zh: 队列超时时间，取值范围5-600秒，默认600秒
QueueTimeout.title_en: 队列超时时间，取值范围5-600秒，默认600秒
QueueTimeout.title_zh: 队列超时时间，取值范围5-600秒，默认600秒

Retry.description_en: The delay in seconds before calling the next agent when the current agent does not answer within the timeout period
Retry.description_zh: 座席超时无应答,呼叫下一座席的延迟秒数
Retry.title_en: 座席超时无应答,呼叫下一座席的延迟秒数
Retry.title_zh: 座席超时无应答,呼叫下一座席的延迟秒数

SayAgentno.description_en:
Specifies whether to announce the agent number. Valid values:
true: enabled.
false: disabled

ServiceLevel.description_en: The service level threshold in seconds. Calls answered within this time are considered to have a high service level
ServiceLevel.description_zh: 服务水平秒数，低于此时间内接听的认为是高服务水平
ServiceLevel.title_en: 服务水平秒数，低于此时间内接听的认为是高服务水平
ServiceLevel.title_zh: 服务水平秒数，低于此时间内接听的认为是高服务水平

Strategy.description_en:
The call strategy. Valid values:
rrordered: skill-based.
rrmemory: round-robin.
fewestcalls: even distribution.
random: random.
linear: sequential.
leastrecent: longest idle time
Strategy.description_zh: 呼叫策略：rrordered:技能优先 rrmemory:轮选 fewestcalls:平均 random:随机 linear:顺序 leastrecent:最长空闲时间
Strategy.title_en: 呼叫策略：rrordered:技能优先 rrmemory:轮选 fewestcalls:平均 random:随机 linear:顺序 leastrecent:最长空闲时间
Strategy.title_zh: 呼叫策略：rrordered:技能优先 rrmemory:轮选 fewestcalls:平均 random:随机 linear:顺序 leastrecent:最长空闲时间

VipSupport.description_en:
Specifies whether VIP is supported. Valid values:
1: Supported.
0: Not supported

Weight.description_en: The queue priority. Valid values: 1 to 10. A higher value indicates a higher priority
Weight.description_zh: 队列优先级，取值范围1-10，数值越高，优先级越高
Weight.title_en: 队列优先级，取值范围1-10，数值越高，优先级越高
Weight.title_zh: 队列优先级，取值范围1-10，数值越高，优先级越高

WrapupTime.description_en: The wrap-up time. Valid values: 3 to 3600. Unit: seconds
